structure.layout: web app with dark-green top nav bar; two-column workspace: wide left column (pool balance summary, warning banner, three suggestion cards, a long awards data table with tabs, filter chips, search and sort) and a narrower sticky right rail (pre-commit checklist and commit summary card with primary commit button)

aesthetics.typography: Source Serif 4 (semibold serif) for the H1, section headings ('Awards', 'Before you commit') and big money figures. Public Sans for all UI text, table cells, chips and buttons, plus small uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows and column headers.
aesthetics.typeScale: Headings use the serif: H1 30px/600, big money figures 24–34px, section H2s 19px. Body and table text 14px, secondary text and chips 12–13px, uppercase eyebrows 12px with tracking. Most of the hierarchy comes from serif-vs-sans and from size on the money figures.

notes: A warm, paper-toned (#f6f3ec/#fffdf8) finance workspace with a deep forest-green app bar and primary button, and amber/brick-red semantics for warnings and blockers. Serif headings and serif dollar figures give it an editorial, ledger-like feel. The narrative is built around one constraint, committed awards $3,800 over the pool: the balance card has an overage bar with a pool marker line, 'Ways to find the $3,800' cards suggest remedies, and a right rail lists blockers and advisory comments. The final 'Commit 57 awards · $188,900' button is disabled (muted green) with red reasons underneath. Vote tallies show bare majorities in amber; early first-spend dates are red. On the live page rows expand inline into line-item editors with vote-dot visualizations, deliberation notes and a 'Defer to January docket' action, and 'Walk back…' opens a formal-rescission modal with an email preview. A new-entry proposal (commit-readiness-checklist) was filed for the 'Before you commit' gating panel, which the codebook has no entry for.
